extraction.Name: St. Elmo Jim
extraction.Recorded patent: yes, filed for record in Pawnee County, Okla., by allottee
extraction.NOTES: Patent delivered June 8, 1918, by mail; receipted for yes; allotment No. 620; NOV 61 20, 75 30; land sold but does not appear allottee was defrauded; has no inherited interest; wife and three children dependent on him; good health; no property or money accumulated; commission expired Jan. 31, 1929; document signed November 28, 1928
